en.t: By this time, the banquet had already been prepared.

units.source_text: 在这个农村里，就是一席饭菜，也要在头一天准备好。

en.t: In this rural village, even a single meal had to be prepared the day before.

units.source_text: 看到这些，我作为不速之客，不觉又自责起来。

en.t: Seeing this, I could not help reproaching myself again for being an uninvited guest.
